description:
**CVRP fleet reduction by route elimination and subsequent distance refinement.** Use homogeneous capacity and a symmetric matrix. Rank final alternatives by number of routes and then distance for this reference case. Savings supplies a feasible starting point.

Try deleting each whole route and pass its customers to an existing-routes-only insertion. Insert heavier demands first. Retain the shortest complete repair with one fewer route and repeat while deletion succeeds.

Pass the reduced solution to 2-opt* and keep further lexicographic improvement. This adapts the separation of fleet reduction and refinement to CVRP without ejection chains. Transfer to a distance-only objective requires adapting the acceptance rule.
